## What's new in 0.4.0
- **Colourful tabs**: every tab now has its own colour, and that colour carries into the tab's sliders, rings and highlights. Prefer one colour? Turn off **Colourful tabs** in Settings → Appearance to use your theme's accent. - **Tab names**: the selected tab shows its name next to the icon, so you always know where you are. Icons are filled and easier to see. - **Redesigned System tab**: Volume, Display and Keyboard sliders with a live percentage, plus cards for battery and Keep Awake. - **Keyboard backlight control**: adjust your keyboard light right from the notch. On Macs with keyboard-light keys, they now show the notch HUD too. - **Redesigned Stats tab**: colourful cards for CPU, Memory, Disk and Network. - **Eyes**: a new idle look for the closed notch. Two eyes sit on either side of the notch, follow your pointer and blink now and then. Turn it on in Settings → Appearance → "When nothing is live, show" → Eyes. - **Hand cursor**: the pointer turns into a hand over anything clickable in the notch.
The keyboard slider only appears on Macs with a backlit keyboard. Showing the HUD for the volume, brightness and keyboard keys still needs Accessibility permission (Settings → System → Replace the HUD).

## What's new in 0.3.0
- **Screen recording from the notch**: record the whole screen, a window or a dragged area, with system audio and/or your mic. A red dot and timer sit beside the notch while recording. ⌃⌥⌘R starts and stops. - **Screenshots**: screen, window or area (⌃⌥⌘S), saved or copied. NotchPilot never shows up in your captures. - **6 new themes**: Sunset, Ocean, Forest, Rose, Gold and Aurora (an animated gradient edge). - **Smoother animations**: a bouncy open, a sliding tab highlight, blur transitions. - **Bigger, easier-to-click buttons** throughout the notch. - **New Settings window** with a sidebar, so every module's settings are easy to find.
Recording needs macOS 15 or later and asks for Screen Recording permission. If it stops working after an update, switch NotchPilot off and on in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen & System Audio Recording.

## What's new in 0.2.0
- Screen Time: Pilot checks in when you've been scrolling too long, and shows your tasks - Tab icons moved to the bottom of the island, away from the camera
